answer_1.quote: We assume access to a dataset ... comprising pairs of statements and their corresponding citations, denoted as (s_i, c_i). Each s_i is a statement from the set S of all statements produced by an LLM ...

answer_2.quote: In our experiments, we assess various widely used faithfulness metrics, categorizing them into similarity‑based, entailment‑based, and LLM‑based metrics.

answer_3.quote: We introduce two prompting methods: (i) Discrete scoring ... and (ii) Continuous scoring ... We use the latest version of GPT-3.5 (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125) as the base model.

answer_4.quote: Human assessors are enrolled to annotate each statement‑citation pair based on the degree to which the citation supports the associated statement. For each pair, human assessors categorize the citation into one of three categories of support levels: full, partial, or no support.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each statement‑citation pair as full support, partial support, or no support.
